The following teams… …need to post this many more tales… …and have participation by this many more authors.
"Children of the Sun" 2 2
"Brass Hearts, Steel Dreams" 4 2

Anyone whose canon is not complete by 11:59 PM, CST tonight will have their canon put into a collapsible at the bottom of the screen until the contest voting is over, at which time, they will be restored.

I currently plan to make no hub page for people who did not meet at least one of the requirements at the end of this contest. I'll send team captains information on the hub pages tomorrow so they can get to work on content for said page.

item.content:encoded:
Quick reminder guys!

Your canon must include a minimum of five (5) tales which can be connected in whatever way you choose.

Don't get disqualified in a couple of days when you've only got three or four! Remember that at least three active team members are required to be considered a group. That means that at least three team members need to have posted a tale.

Get on it, guys!
